property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Title Trait] STARTING PLOT POINTS 0
[Title Trait] CONTINUITY When Captain Kirk is KO'd, friendly characters are given two action tokens that don't cause pushing damage.
[Plus Plot Points] LET'S NOT SPEND ETERNITY IN FUTILE, BLOODY VIOLENCE FREE: Until your next turn, when a friendly character is missed by an attack, after resolutions remove an action token from that character.
[Minus Plot Points] TRANSPORTER FREE: Choose a character on your sideline with the Starfleet keyword and a starting line for that character. You may remove 1 Plot Point plus 1 Plot Point per 10 full points of that character's cost to place that character on the chosen starting line in an unoccupied square within 6 squares and line of fire. A force may have only one character placed by this effect on the map at a time. (Example: You would remove 5 Plot Points for a 40-49 point character.)
